A daily, timestamped record of market moves, the mechanism behind each, and
predictions that are scored after the fact.

::: {.callout-note title="How this journal is written" icon=false}
Every entry takes one market move and follows the same four steps.

1. **Observation.** What happened, in numbers only: the move, the benchmark's move, and anything unusual such as volume.
2. **Mechanism.** Why it happened. I name the channel first (cash flows, the risk-free rate, the risk premium, or flows), then write the causal chain one link at a time, and test it against the data.
3. **Prediction.** What I expect next: one testable statement with a deadline, a probability, and the result that would prove it wrong.
4. **Scoring.** Completed when the deadline arrives: whether the call was right, and which link in the reasoning held or broke.

Predictions are published before their outcomes are known, and entries are
not edited afterwards except to add the score.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="The watchlist" icon=false}
The journal tracks 49 instruments, grouped by what each is sensitive to, so
that every kind of macro event has a clear test case. Daily moves and trend
measures for all of them are on the [Dashboard](dashboard.qmd).

| Group | Instruments |
|---|---|
| Macro series | ^TNX (10-year Treasury yield), ^VIX (volatility index), DX-Y.NYB (US dollar index), CL=F (crude oil futures), GC=F (gold futures), HG=F (copper futures) |
| Benchmarks | SPY, QQQ, IWM |
| Bonds and credit | TLT, TIP, LQD, HYG |
| Rate-sensitive | JPM, BAC, KRE, XLU, DHI, O |
| Long-duration growth | MSFT, AAPL, AMZN, GOOGL, META, TSLA |
| Semiconductors | NVDA, AMD, AVGO, TSM, SMH |
| Commodity-linked | XOM, CVX, FCX, GLD, SLV |
| Cyclical | CAT, UNP, HD, DAL |
| Defensive | PG, KO, WMT |
| Healthcare | XLV, JNJ, LLY, UNH |
| International | EEM, FXI, EWJ |

**How to use the Dashboard.** Start with the macro series to see what rates,
volatility, the dollar, and commodities did. Then compare the groups: which
ones moved with the benchmark and which diverged. A divergence is usually
where the day's entry begins.
:::
